newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLAIPEDA PORT ACTIVITY UP IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: KLAIPEDA PORT ACTIVITY UP IN MARCH.

text.p: The port of Klaipeda said on Tuesday that it reloaded 1.51 million tonnes of cargo in March versus 1.32 million tonnes in February.

The port reloaded 4.01 million tonnes of cargo in the 1Q of 1997 compared with 2.66 million tonnes in the first three months of 1996, Antanas Chyzhas, an official in the port's marketing department, told Reuters.
He added that a break-down of what percentage was unloaded and what percentage was loaded will be available later this month.
Chyzhas said that a mild winter was one of the reasons behind the port's increased activity.

Chyzhas said that state-run Klaipeda stevedoring company, KLASCO, was the most active loader, with its turn-over rising to 2.29 million tonnes in the 1Q of 1997 from 1.56 million tonnes in the same period last year.
Klaipedos Natfa's volume rose to 779,600 tonnes in the first three months of this year compared to 300,000 tonnes in the same period in 1996, Chyzhas said.
